candidates.name: PipelineML Conceptual and Encoding Model
verified_facts: PipelineML defines concepts for interoperable exchange of oil and gas pipeline-system information.
The standard addresses use cases including new-construction surveys and pipeline rehabilitation.
semantic_limits: Pipeline asset/survey exchange does not establish bare-earth parcel DTM values or complete vertical uncertainty for unrelated land parcels.

candidates.name: Points of Interest (POI)
verified_facts: The OGC POI activity defines a standard model for representing point-of-interest data across applications and platforms.
POI information can contain geographic locations with names, descriptions, categories and related metadata.
semantic_limits: A point-of-interest location is an application feature and is not a surveyed ground point or parcel elevation measurement.
